ns2:course.label: Business of Entertainment Design
ns2:course.description: Practical approaches to working as a professional designer. Material covered includes: unions and union membership, contract negotiation and execution, how to get an agent, the difference between assistant and associate designers, urban survival, creating personal websites, touring, residencies, etc. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours.
